legend.title: Theta coherence between RSC and dHC, Early (Precon1) against Late (Precon4).
legend.body: (a) The five regions; this pair lit, its edge's width the change in its mean coherence. notes: r8 Precon1 p01: Every one of the 14 channels these regions need is invalidated for this event, so there is nothing left to correlate.
flag_say: Pooled spectra, not the mean of trials. Within each rat and day, every 1 s piece of every trial's window goes into one spectrum before the coherence is taken. Dickson et al. and tabs 8 and 9 take one coherence per trial and average them. Pooling is less biased, but it only gives a high value when the phase relation holds across trials. The mean of the trials is shown beside it.
